headline: Asus ROG Strix Scar 18 starts at $4,299.99 with mini-LED display, RTX 5090
summary: Asus' ROG Strix Scar 18 gaming laptop features a stunning mini-LED display and Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 graphics.
details: The Asus ROG Strix Scar 18 is a high-performance gaming laptop with a gorgeous 18-inch mini-LED display and a powerful Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 graphics card. It starts at $4,299.99 and features a Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus processor.

The laptop has a unique design with a scrolling marquee lighting on its lid and a vibrant Aura Sync lightbar around the base. It also has a solid build quality, but its large footprint and heavy weight make it less portable.

In terms of performance, the Scar 18 was competitive across the board at 1200p, but trailed the Razer Blade 18 in most games at 4K resolution. The laptop's single-channel RAM might affect its performance.
The Scar 18 has a wide range of connectivity options, including two Thunderbolt 5 ports, three USB-A 3.2 Gen 2 ports, HDMI 2.1, and 2.5 Gbps Ethernet. It also features Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4.
caption:
Can a $4,299.99 gaming laptop deliver top performance? Asus ROG Strix Scar 18 review

The Asus ROG Strix Scar 18 is a high-performance gaming laptop with a gorgeous 18-inch mini-LED display and a powerful Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 graphics card. It starts at $4,299.99 and features a Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus processor.

The laptop has a unique design with a scrolling marquee lighting on its lid and a vibrant Aura Sync lightbar around the base. It also has a solid build quality, but its large footprint and heavy weight make it less portable.

In terms of performance, the Scar 18 was competitive across the board at 1200p, but trailed the Razer Blade 18 in most games at 4K resolution. The laptop's single-channel RAM might affect its performance.

The Scar 18 has a wide range of connectivity options, including two Thunderbolt 5 ports, three USB-A 3.2 Gen 2 ports, HDMI 2.1, and 2.5 Gbps Ethernet. It also features Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4.
